about: An Associate Degree (D3) graduate in Informatics Engineering from State Polytechnic of Banjarmasin, certified as a Junior Computer Technician by BNSP, specializing in network infrastructure and IT Support. Possesses over 1.5 years of technical work experience spanning international-scale hotel network maintenance, communication network installation in remote sites, and administrative web platform management. Proficient in hardware and software troubleshooting, digital operational efficiency, and cross-divisional technical communication to maintain optimal system uptime.
